title: Miasma Scavenger
overview: Ruud, who is an adventurer in the remote city of Barona, has no fighting ability and is hated by his fellow adventurers, calling him a "miasma scavenger.". He spends his days exploring the miasma labyrinth using his only skill, "state anomaly nullification," but one day he hears that a new labyrinth has been discovered. An adventurer calls out to Ruud, who is about to head towards her.

title: Monster Eater
overview: Ruud is invited by the adventurer Bayer to accompany him to the New Labyrinth as a porter for his party, the Scarlet Sword. The strategy progresses smoothly, but a powerful enemy, the Minotaur, that should not have appeared appears...!?

title: Crimson Blade
overview: At the guild, Vaiell delivered the lie with a pale face. "The Minotaur killed him. Rude is dead". Fear gripped the room. But then, the doors creaked open. A heavy scent of blood and miasma flooded the hall as a shadow emerged. "Dead? That's news to me, Vaiell". It was Rude. But his eyes were no longer those of a scavenger-they were the eyes of a predator.

title: Adventurer Hunting
overview: Rude falls into the trap of the Lizardman and finds herself in a predicament. Observing the enemy in search of a solution, he notices the alien skills hidden in an individual. At that time, I met an elf girl who was about to fall into the hands of an adventurer hunting demon.

title: Elysia of the Jade Storm
overview: Five years ago, the Elf girl Elysia lost everything in the labyrinth. Her party disbanded, and she was struck by a cruel "Level-Down Curse". As her strength withered away, it was Rude, the shunned adventurer, who reached out to save her.
